FALLING FROM THE SKY • XRP LEDGER

NFT CATCH

Catch real NFTs from xrp.cafe’s top 30 collections. Slide the blue xrp.cafe logo cup left & right — finger, mouse, or ← → keys.

✦ Gold NEW MINT = 100 pts
Every 10 caught = Level Up, everything falls faster — and Level Up refills your hearts to full.
❤️ Energy Hearts fall too — catch one for +1 heart (max 3).

Miss 3 and it’s game over.

Move: drag / move mouse on the field, or use ← → / A D. On phones, slide your finger — the blue xrp.cafe catcher follows. Tip: stay under the gold NEW MINT when it flashes at the top.

What’s falling?

Every tile that falls is a real NFT — the actual artwork and name of an actual token — randomised on every drop from the top 30 collections by 24h volume on xrp.cafe via XRPL.to, checked Fri Nov 13, 2026. Three real NFTs per collection are in the mix, and Animal Fam is weighted 4-in-31 — it falls about 13% of the time, roughly 4× any other single collection; the other 29 collections share the remaining 27-in-31 evenly. Floors are that day’s snapshot for scoring flavour, not live prices.

✦ RARE DROP  NEW MINT — every so often (roughly every 20–30 seconds) one of the real NFTs drops in a glowing gold frame as a fresh mint. Worth 100 points and falls a touch faster, so be ready.

❤️ ENERGY HEART  Energy Heart — a big glowing, pulsing red heart falls every so often alongside the NFTs. It is not an NFT and not a NEW MINT. Catch it to get +1 heart back, up to the max of 3 hearts. If you are already at 3 hearts it shows “ALREADY FULL” and gives no extra heart. Missing a heart costs nothing.

How to Play

  • Catch an NFT by sliding the blue xrp.cafe logo catcher under it — NFTs drop into the white cup.
  • Every 10 caught you level up — fall speed and spawn rate both bump up.
  • ⚡ Level Up refill + flash: reaching a new level refills your hearts / energy back to full — 3 hearts, no matter how many you had left. The whole screen then blinks and flashes with a LEVEL UP celebration and the game pauses there until you tap to continue. (If your device is set to Reduce Motion, the flashing is off — you still get the refill, the LEVEL UP message, and the tap to continue.)
  • Animal Fam 4-in-31: about 13% of all drops are Animal Fam — roughly 4× any other single collection. The other 29 collections split the rest evenly.
  • Points follow the collection’s floor price: floor 500+ XRP pays 50, 200+ pays 35, 100+ pays 25, 40+ pays 20, 15+ pays 15, the rest 10 — and the gold NEW MINT pays 100.
  • Misses: you have 3 hearts. A missed NFT costs 1 heart. At 0 hearts it’s game over — so from full hearts, miss 3 and it’s game over.
  • ❤️ Energy Hearts: a big glowing, pulsing red heart falls every so often, separate from the NFTs and the gold NEW MINT. Catch it for +1 heart, up to the max of 3 hearts. If you’re already at 3 hearts, it shows ALREADY FULL and gives no extra heart. Energy Hearts give no points, don’t count toward the 10 for a Level Up, and missing one costs nothing.
